table.name: TLGNC_EXT_MATERIAL
table.description: External materials, as used in the Use Case '3rd party orders', aka 'External orders'. An external material is basically just a name, and maintained by the carriers directly. When creating an external order, the user can select the material from the list. The typical usage is 'copy' (not 'reference'): i.e the external order does not have a reference to the ext_material anymore.

column.name: CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. The vendor/carrier which created/maintains this external material.

column.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: 0=inactive/deleted, 1=active. Inactive materials are not shown in the selection drop downs in the application, but still visible in the administration pages.

column.name: MATERIAL_NAME
column.description: Name of the material, equivalent to tlgns_sap_material_description.txt, but language-independent. When creating an external order, this value is copied into tlgnc_assignment.material_name.

column.name: MATERIAL_COMMENT
column.description: Comment about external material. Only visible in the administration pages, not in the application.
